title: Add simple password-based admin access to unblock menu management

requirements.text: Implement a simple password-based admin unlock so the user can access the admin dashboard and manage menu items (including image upload and price) using the password "admin 9828".

quotes:
Tum simple sa system kar do ki password add kar do jis se me mera menu abb kar saku food item image or price...
Password - admin 9828

acceptanceCriteria: When a user visits /admin and is not yet authorized, the UI provides an input for an admin password (not "token")
Entering the exact password "admin 9828" and submitting results in the user becoming authorized as an admin for the current session and gaining access to the admin dashboard routes
After successful password submission, the admin check succeeds (no more "Access Denied" / "Admin token required" blocking state)
If the password is incorrect, the UI shows a clear error message and admin access is not granted
Admin authorization remains enforced for all admin-only backend methods (category/item CRUD, reordering, analytics)

requirements.text: Update the admin access screen copy to use clear English and reflect password-based access: replace "Admin Token" wording with "Admin Password" and ensure the call-to-action explains that the password is required to access the admin dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: On the /admin guard screen, labels/placeholder/button text use "Admin Password" / "Enter admin password" / "Submit Password" (or equivalent) instead of "Admin Token"
Any error/help text displayed to the user is in English

requirements.text: Ensure the password entry flow integrates with the existing session-based secret storage so that after password submission the actor is re-initialized and admin status is rechecked automatically without requiring the user to edit the URL manually.

quotes: Tum simple sa system kar do ki password add kar do...

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the admin password stores it in session storage under the existing secret key used for admin initialization ("caffeineAdminToken")
After submission, the frontend refreshes/recreates the backend actor and re-runs the admin check automatically
A page refresh during the same browser session keeps the admin access working (until the session ends/clears)

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not add third-party authentication providers; keep Internet Identity as-is and add password as a simple admin unlock mechanism on top of the existing flow.
nonGoals: Building a full user management system for multiple admins.
Adding password reset, email/SMS verification, or persistent credential storage beyond what is required for the simple admin unlock.
Replacing or removing Internet Identity authentication entirely.
